name: DupeDonors
author: xbmc4lyfe
license: See the repository; vendor/ptt is MIT
about: Adds health-checked duplicate postings of every new download as nzbget dupe backups.
requirements: A newznab indexer or aggregator, for example NZBHydra2.
description: When an NZB is added, Dupe Donors searches the indexer for other postings of the same release, checks how much of each still exists on your news servers, and adds the live ones under the download's DupeKey, most complete first.
If the download fails, nzbget's duplicate handling switches to the best of them. With the PR 850 build it also borrows missing articles from them.
A download whose articles exist on no server is demoted at once, so the best donor takes over.

options.name: HydraUrl
description: Base URL of the newznab indexer, for example http://127.0.0.1:5076 for NZBHydra2.

options.name: HydraApiKey
description: API key of the indexer.

options.name: MaxDonors
description: Most donors to add per download. 0 means no limit.

options.name: SizeTolerance
description: 0: size is not a filter (postings of one release can differ by gigabytes). 0.2: skip results more than 20% off in size.

options.name: HealthPercent
description: Share of each posting's articles to check on the news servers. 0 turns health checks off.

options.name: HealthMinArticles
description: Fewest articles to check per posting.

options.name: HealthMaxArticles
description: Most articles to check per posting.

options.name: BodyPercent
description: Share of the checked articles that are also downloaded and verified (yEnc CRC).

options.name: BodyMaxPerNzb
description: Most articles to download per posting. Each is about 750 KB.

options.name: DonorMinAlive
description: Postings with less than this share of their articles on any server are dropped.

options.name: HealthBudget
description: Seconds of checking per posting.

options.name: FastDonors
description: Donors added right after a quick 10-article check. The rest are added after a full check.

options.name: NzbsToCheckConcurrently
description: Postings checked at the same time.

options.name: NntpServerConnectionPerNzb
description: Connections per news server for each posting being checked.

options.name: MaxConnsPerNntpServer
description: Most connections per news server for checks. Never more than half of the server's Connections.

options.name: PrimaryScore
description: DupeScore given to a download without a DupeKey or with a lower score. Donors score just below it.

options.name: SettleSeconds
description: Seconds to wait after a download is added, so the submitter's own backups arrive first.

options.name: DryRun
description: yes: search and check, and log what would be added, without changing anything in nzbget.

options.name: StateDir
description: Folder for the state file and log. Empty means MainDir/dupe-donors.

commands.name: ConnectionTest
description: Checks that the indexer answers and lists the news servers used for health checks.
